English.Char_Desc_45: Real-time hardware monitor for Windows PCs
English.Char_Desc_80: Lightweight overlay: CPU, GPU, RAM, disk, network & power telemetry.
English.Char_Desc_250: RIGStats is a lightweight, open-source hardware monitoring dashboard for Windows. It displays real-time telemetry for your entire rig - CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, network and system power - in a clean, always-visible overlay.
English.Char_Desc_450: RIGStats is a lightweight, open-source hardware monitoring dashboard for Windows. It displays real-time telemetry for your entire rig - CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, network and system power - in a clean, always-visible overlay. Features sparkline panels, portrait/landscape profiles, wallpaper mode, floating overlay, Fill Screen mode, auto-updater, and a bundled sensor service powered by LibreHardwareMonitor.
English.Char_Desc_2000: RIGStats is a lightweight, open-source hardware monitoring dashboard for Windows. It displays real-time telemetry for your entire rig - CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, network and system power - in a clean, always-visible overlay. Features sparkline panels, portrait/landscape profiles, wallpaper mode, floating overlay, Fill Screen mode, auto-updater, and a bundled sensor service powered by LibreHardwareMonitor. Requires Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit). Free and open source, no telemetry, no bloat.
